# Ankit Kumar

> Infrastructure engineer at Wolters Kluwer shipping software and AI tooling. Splunk multi-site clusters, Azure, AWS, Terraform at work; MCP, AI-assisted ops, and a multi-agent dev environment (Paperclip + Honcho + GitNexus + Hermes) outside it. Based in Pune, India, relocating to Germany. Open to software and AI engineering roles in Germany.

## Selected Projects (production)

- [Splunk multi-site cluster migration](https://iankitkumar.in/work/splunk-multisite-migration/): WK ARC-certified multi-site topology; RTO/RPO and DR readiness improved.
- [Multi-cloud Splunk upgrade automation](https://iankitkumar.in/work/splunk-upgrade-automation/): AWS SSM/EC2 + Azure Run Command with automatic rollback; 20,000+ endpoints at 99.9% success.
- [Subscription migration across 25 Azure tenants](https://iankitkumar.in/work/subscription-migration/): 2.5–3 month program; 200–300 subscriptions migrated under standard governance policies.
- [Tech-debt scanning across 2,500+ subscriptions](https://iankitkumar.in/work/tech-debt-scanning/): Python + PowerShell; 2,000+ flagged resources resolved on demand.
- [Splunk dashboards for SOC2 + financial reporting](https://iankitkumar.in/work/soc2-dashboards/): Audit-ready telemetry and financial compliance reporting.
- [Global Windows endpoint operations](https://iankitkumar.in/work/global-endpoints/): 20K+ endpoints, 79 factories, 70 countries (Colgate GBS).

## Selected Projects (security / ML research)

- [NIDS — network intrusion detection with deep learning](https://iankitkumar.in/work/nids-ml-dl/): Comparative study of deep models for network intrusion detection.
- [IDS — grid search over classical ML for intrusion detection](https://iankitkumar.in/work/ids-mlp-gridsearch/): Hyperparameter search across classical ML baselines.

## Experiments (software + AI engineering, outside the day job)

- [MCP server: Splunk query planner](https://iankitkumar.in/experiments/): TypeScript Model Context Protocol server exposing SPL authoring and indexer cluster health to LLM clients.
- [AI-assisted triage for Splunk security alerts](https://iankitkumar.in/experiments/): Python pipeline that turns LLM structured output into enriched Splunk notable events (severity, MITRE ATT&CK, next step).

## Tools (open source, built to stop doing something by hand)

- [kittybot](https://iankitkumar.in/tools/kittybot/): Telegram bot that pulls grocery orders from Swiggy Instamart, Zepto, Blinkit and BigBasket, and writes the shared expenses to Kittysplit — only after you approve every split. Python, aiogram, MCP/OAuth, read-only adapters. [Source](https://github.com/i-ankitkumar/kittybot)
- [All tools](https://iankitkumar.in/tools/)
